title: feat: enhance List and Form View protocols with detailed configuration schemas
body:
## Enhanced List View and Form View Protocol

### Completed

- [x] 1. Create `ListColumnSchema` for detailed column configuration
  - [x] Add properties: `field`, `label`, `width`, `align`, `hidden`, `sortable`, `resizable`, `wrap`, `type`
  - [x] Add validation: `width` must be positive
  - [x] Add validation tests for negative/zero width
- [x] 2. Update `ListViewSchema` to support enhanced columns
  - [x] Support both string[] (legacy) and ListColumnSchema[] (new)
  - [x] Add `resizable`, `striped`, `bordered` features
  - [x] Add `selection` configuration (`type`: none/single/multiple)
  - [x] Add `pagination` configuration (`pageSize`, `pageSizeOptions`)
  - [x] Add validation: `pageSize` and `pageSizeOptions` must be positive integers
  - [x] Add validation tests for negative/zero/non-integer values
- [x] 3. Create `FormFieldSchema` for detailed form field configuration
  - [x] Add properties: `field`, `label`, `placeholder`, `helpText`, `readonly`, `required`, `hidden`, `colSpan`
  - [x] Add `dependsOn`, `visibleOn` for conditional logic
  - [x] Add `widget` for custom component specification
  - [x] Add validation: `colSpan` must be integer between 1-4
  - [x] Add validation tests for colSpan boundary values
- [x] 4. Update `FormSectionSchema` to support mixed field types
  - [x] Allow `z.array(z.union([z.string(), FormFieldSchema]))`
  - [x] Fix documentation error: fields type corrected to `(string | object)[]`
- [x] 5. Add comprehensive tests for all new schemas
  - [x] 86 view.test.ts tests (30 new validation tests added)
  - [x] All 257 UI tests passing
- [x] 6. Validate with build and existing tests
- [x] 7. Address code review feedback with proper validation constraints
- [x] 8. Merge ViewDataSchema from PR #95 for dual-mode support
- [x] 9. Fix build errors and test failures

### Summary

All enhancements have been successfully implemented, tested, and merged with the latest main branch changes. The changes maintain backward compatibility while enabling rich, metadata-driven configurations for frontend teams. Added comprehensive validation tests as requested in code review.

<!-- START COPILOT ORIGINAL PROMPT -->



<details>

<summary>Original prompt</summary>

> The current metadata-driven frontend protocol for Forms and Tables in `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` is insufficiently detailed for building robust frontend controls.
> 
> The following improvements are needed:
> 
> 1.  **Enhanced List View Protocol (`ListViewSchema`)**:
>     -   **Columns**: Upgrade `columns` from a simple string array to support a detailed configuration object (`ListColumnSchema`).
>         -   Properties: `field` (name), `label`, `width`, `align` (left/center/right), `hidden`, `sortable`, `resizable`, `wrap`, `type` (renderer override).
>     -   **Features**: Add `resizable` (columns), `striped` (rows), `bordered`.
>     -   **Selection**: Add `selection` configuration (`type`: none/single/multiple).
>     -   **Pagination**: Add `pagination` configuration (`pageSize`, `pageSizeOptions`).
> 
> 2.  **Enhanced Form View Protocol (`FormViewSchema`)**:
>     -   **Fields**: Upgrade `fields` in `FormSectionSchema` to support a detailed configuration object (`FormFieldSchema`).
>         -   Properties: `field` (name), `label` override, `placeholder`, `helpText`, `readonly` override, `required` override, `hidden` override, `colSpan` (grid width).
>     -   **Dependencies**: Add `dependsOn` (field name) and `visibleOn` (expression) to `FormFieldSchema` for conditional logic.
>     -   **Controls**: Add `widget` property to `FormFieldSchema` to specify custom components.
> 
> 3.  **Refactor `FormSectionSchema`**:
>     -   Allow mixed types in `fields`: `z.array(z.union([z.string(), FormFieldSchema]))`.
> 
> These changes will provide a comprehensive standard for the frontend team to implement rich, metadata-driven UI components.
> 


</details>
